normalized_matching_profile.description: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Steps from the beach- 3 adult bikes- Resort-Style Amenities at Waterhouse Complex- Rooftop pool and hot tub- Community private beach access - Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Seacrest Beach Waterhouse 102 is the perfect 3-bedrooms, 3-bath condo to stay in for your next sunny vacation. Located in the 4-story Waterhouse complex, you and your guests can access on-site, resort-style amenities via the elevator, including a rooftop pool and spa, 2 community grills, private fitness center with sauna, and outdoor shower. Waterhouse 102 is centrally located between Rosemary Beach and Seaside with beach access directly across the street just minutes from the Gulf of Mexico. This unit is conveniently located on the first floor and is accessible to everyone for the ultimate dream vacation.This beautifully appointed condo is perfect for entertaining friends or family get-togethers. The open living room, dining area, and kitchen all flow together seamlessly with hardwood floors and upscale furnishings. From a comfy linen couch to 2 armchairs, you’ll enjoy the subtle beachy decor that is accented throughout the condo with soft blues and whites.The chef’s kitchen is the heart of the home and is filled with high-end stainless steel Viking appliances. The lovely blue-green breakfast bar with 4 stools creates a splash of color while enjoying your morning cup of coffee; whereas the sturdy granite countertops, white cabinets, and tile backsplash complete the look of this clean space. Entertain guests as they wait for their homecooked meal at the 8-seat dining room table—listen to music, play cards, or retell old stories.Take in the beauty of the area via the private covered patio that runs the length of the condo along 30A. It’s a great place to enjoy a late-night cocktail or escape the kids for some peace and quiet. There’s also a private exterior storage closet that’s ideal for stowing wet beach gear, and there’s a full-sized washer and dryer to clean things before heading home.Stay in our beautiful Gulf-coast home today and enjoy the 3 adult bikes that are accessible to you, as well as plenty of other amenities. Don’t miss out—you could be relaxing on the beach right now!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 8):FIRST FLOOR:Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and TubGuest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyGuest Bedroom: Queen Bed over Two Twins, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo*Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and Callista Vacation Rentals fines.*This property has a strict non-smoking policy. Violation of this policy puts the guest at risk of being fined and/or evicted.*Beach chair service is available at cost to the guests from March 1st to November 15th.

Located in the 4-story Waterhouse complex, you and your guests can access on-site, resort-style amenities via the elevator, including a rooftop pool and spa, 2 community grills, private fitness center with sauna, and outdoor shower. Waterhouse 102 is centrally located between Rosemary Beach and Seaside with beach access directly across the street just minutes from the Gulf of Mexico. This unit is conveniently located on the first floor and is accessible to everyone for the ultimate dream vacation. This beautifully appointed condo is perfect for entertaining friends or family get-togethers. The open living room, dining area, and kitchen all flow together seamlessly with hardwood floors and upscale furnishings. From a comfy linen couch to 2 armchairs, you’ll enjoy the subtle beachy decor that is accented throughout the condo with soft blues and whites. The chef’s kitchen is the heart of the home and is filled with high-end stainless steel Viking appliances. The lovely blue-green breakfast bar with 4 stools creates a splash of color while enjoying your morning cup of coffee; whereas the sturdy granite countertops, white cabinets, and tile backsplash complete the look of this clean space. Entertain guests as they wait for their homecooked meal at the 8-seat dining room table—listen to music, play cards, or retell old stories. Take in the beauty of the area via the private covered patio that runs the length of the condo along 30A. It’s a great place to enjoy a late-night cocktail or escape the kids for some peace and quiet. There’s also a private exterior storage closet that’s ideal for stowing wet beach gear, and there’s a full-sized washer and dryer to clean things before heading home. Stay in our beautiful Gulf-coast home today and enjoy the 3 adult bikes that are accessible to you, as well as plenty of other amenities. Don’t miss out—you could be relaxing on the beach right now!
